chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

The prescribed punishment of flogging is that the two are found in a single covering; and two men are flogged if they are found in a single covering, and two women are flogged if they are found in a single covering—the prescribed punishment.

key_terms.الْجَلْدِ: flogging as a corporal legal punishment
key_terms.حَدُّ: the prescribed legal punishment or fixed penalty
key_terms.لِحَافٍ: a covering or blanket under which people lie
key_terms.يُجْلَدَانِ: the two are to be flogged

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhib al-Ahkam on two men or two women being found under one covering?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the hadd of flogging in the case of two men or two women being found together under a single covering. It belongs to the jurisprudence of prescribed punishments and indicates a punishable illicit circumstance short of the explicit act of zina.
